records.scope: Flask application implementing the porsche.com/usa mirror: the model lineup (overview with range/body/fuel/transmission filters and price/power sorts, per-range pages, per-variant detail pages with the live site's technical data tables, highlights and standard equipment), the configurator (8 real model codes with their real US-market option catalogs, selectable options with prices, running total, saveable builds), the Porsche Finder (search over real in-stock listings with condition/model/body/transmission/drivetrain/fuel/color/dealer/price/year/mileage filters, six sort orders, pagination, detail pages with VIN, price breakdown and lease estimate, saveable vehicles), the dealer search (218 US Porsche Centers, state browse + name/city/ZIP search, opening hours), the Porsche Shop (3 categories, product pages, cart, checkout with validation and order confirmation), and the My Porsche account domain (register/sign-in, profile, saved vehicles, saved builds, orders). Route and URL shapes follow the live site (/usa/models/, /configurator/en-US/mode/model/<code>, /finder/us/en-US/search, /finder/us/en-US/details/<slug>, /usa/dealersearch/, shop.porsche.com paths, /my-porsche/).

Deterministic build-time/boot-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data/ snapshots; benchmark users share one frozen bcrypt digest so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build (PYTHONHASHSEED=0).

Frozen snapshot of the live /usa/models/ ModelOverview island as served on 2026-09-24: all 76 US model variants with the live site's own MSRP (value + formatted), max power (hp), model year, body type, drivetrain, seats, fuel and transmission labels, 0-60 and top-track-speed highlights, standard equipment highlights, leasing example, detail-page URL and configurator code. Merged with each variant's live detail page (/usa/models/<range>/<series>/<slug>/) technical data categories (Motor, Performance, Transmission, Chassis, Dimensions, Capacities...) and highlights attributes, extracted verbatim from the captured renders by scripts_dev/extract_model_cards.py + scripts_dev/build_source_data.py.

Real configurator option catalogs captured from configurator.porsche.com/en-US/mode/model/<code> for 8 model codes (992142 911 Carrera GTS, 9921B2 911 Carrera, Y1AAI1 Taycan, YAAAA1 Panamera, 95BAU1 Macan, XABBB1 Macan 4 Electric, 9YAAI1 Cayenne, X1ABB1 Cayenne S Electric): each option's id, on-page label with live US price (e.g. 'Jet Black Metallic, Price: $880') and its swatch image URL. 331 options total.
The full rendered option panel text of the 911 Carrera GTS configurator page (992142) as displayed on configurator.porsche.com, captured 2026-09-24.

Real in-stock vehicle listings captured from finder.porsche.com/us/en-US/search on 2026-09-24: 442 unique listings harvested from the search result pages' embedded RSC payloads (listing id, URL slug, full title, condition, price, VIN, model year, exterior/interior color, transmission, drivetrain, engine type, hp/kW, mileage, previous owners, body type, dimensions, weight, selling Porsche Center with partner number, distance text, price breakdown incl. base MSRP / equipment price / delivery fee / dealer add-ons / dealer fees / total, and Porsche Financial Services lease/finance estimate) joined with the schema.org JSON-LD Car entities embedded in the same result pages. 395 of 442 listings carry the live site's own payment estimate; every listing carries a VIN.

All 218 US Porsche Centers exactly as served by the live /usa/dealersearch/ page's embedded island state on 2026-09-24: PPN org id, partner number, name, street/city/state/ZIP, phone, email, homepage, contact and service opening hours per weekday, and coordinates for all 45 states with a center.

Porsche Shop catalog captured from shop.porsche.com/us/en-US (vehicle accessories, clothing, home & lifestyle category pages) on 2026-09-24: 188 unique products with the Algolia InstantSearch payloads embedded in the pages - name, SKU, slug, brand, main category, category taxonomy, description, USD gross price, stock flag, color/size attributes, labels, and real product photo URLs from the shop's own CDN.
Rendered copy of the live https://www.porsche.com/usa/ homepage on 2026-09-24 (model line blurbs, prices, section copy) used for the mirror homepage.
Per-file inventory (bytes, SHA-256, upstream source URL) for every managed image under static/images/; enforced by the image build's check_asset_inventory.py gate.
Model cards and detail-page gallery imagery captured from images.porsche.com (bounded 870x260 renditions of the live site's own side/technical shots), 660 files.
One real photo per in-stock listing, captured from the finder.porsche.com image CDN (the exact 480px rendition the live search cards embed), 442 files.
Product photos from the Porsche Shop's own product CDN (product-domain-assets.ppim.aws.porsche.cloud), up to two per product, 347 files.
Option swatches captured from configurator.porsche.com's own asset paths (/assets/exteriors/...), 158 files (options without a visual swatch on the live page have none here either).
Homepage hero imagery captured from images.porsche.com as referenced by the live homepage markup.
Site chrome written for the mirror (Porsche design language: black wordmark header, red accents, neutral palette). No upstream stylesheets are copied.

Two My Porsche demo accounts with the frozen WebHarbor benchmark password (TestPass123!), following the standard per-site benchmark-user pattern. Their saved vehicles/builds/orders start empty and are created by agent interaction.
Build-time harvest and assembly tooling (offline extractors for the cached captures, the source_data builder, the image downloader). Not shipped in the image.

Pytest suite (not shipped in the image): tasks contract (5-key rows, 15-25 count, no answer keys, goal-style <=100 words, domain spread), seed determinism (integrity, source-snapshot match, idempotent re-import, byte-reproducible canonical rebuild), and app robustness (all surfaces render, filters/sorts behave, CSRF enforced on every POST, auth/save-build/cart/checkout flows persist, bad input fails cleanly, catalog richness supports the task set).
All state-changing POST routes (sign-in, register, save vehicle, save build, cart add/update, checkout) validate a per-session token; forms render it and missing/mismatched tokens fail with 400.

20 goal-style agent tasks (29-92 words, 5 contributor keys only, no answer key) spanning the model lineup, configurator, Porsche Finder, dealer search, Porsche Shop and My Porsche account domains. Every task requires multi-page navigation plus multi-fact extraction (15-22 honest steps by per-fact count; scripted-headless-browser minimal paths run 7-19 actions as the conservative lower bound). Ground truth is anchored exclusively to the deterministic seed (VINs, prices, hours, partner numbers, SKUs).
